issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

krbFilePath.description:
File path to local krb5 configuration file. The file path should end with krb5.conf or krb5.ini.
e.g /etc/krb5.conf

krbContent.description:
This will be ignored if krbFilePath is set.
The Kerberos configuration content for realms and hostnames.
Content can be provided as plain text string, and use "\\n" for line breakers.

title:
Type to provide system level configuration for Kerberos. There can only be single krb file/content.
This config will throw error if neither of krbFilePath or krbContent is set.
name: KerberosConfig
